releaseNotesMarkdown:
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/mveinot/transmission-control/compare/v2.3.0.425...v2.4.0.439

Notable changes:

* Hardened the .torrent parser
* Added the Theme Manager with external theme pack management
* Added a checkbox for each file in the Files list to toggle wanted state
* Added bulk tracker editing in the torrent properties dialog
* Added several new themes to the website
* Updated bundled libmaxminddb to the latest release
